tools.name: search_compounds
tools.description:
Find compounds on SharpSyn by name, synonym, CAS number, InChIKey or
    molecular formula. Returns name, CAS, InChIKey, page URL and a summary of
    suppliers, price and carbon footprint for each match, best matches first.

tools.name: get_compound
tools.description:
Everything SharpSyn publishes about one compound, given its CAS number,
    InChIKey or name: identifiers, structure (SMILES, InChI), number of verified
    suppliers with regions, grades and lead times, price range per kg with its
    confidence label and data date, the cradle-to-gate carbon footpr

tools.name: list_suppliers
tools.description:
Suppliers listed publicly on SharpSyn (companies that asked to be listed),
    optionally only those in one country or offering one compound (CAS, InChIKey
    or name). Returns company name, country, website, number of public listings
    and the profile URL.

tools.name: request_quote_link
tools.description:
A link the user opens to ask SharpSyn's suppliers for a quote on a
    compound (CAS number, InChIKey or name). Nothing is sent by calling this:
    the user fills in quantities and sends the request themselves.

tools.name: where_is_it_made
tools.description:
Where a compound is produced, from the SharpSyn Chemical World Map:
    the known production sites (name, operator, country, coordinates), how
    they spread over countries (share per country, single-site warning), the
    confidence and source of each entry, and the page and map links to cite.

tools.name: value_chain
tools.description:
What a compound is made from (direction 'up', its precursors) or what
    it is used to make ('down', derived products), following main industrial
    routes for `depth` steps (1 to 4). Each entry has its name, CAS and page
    URL where SharpSyn has one.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_compounds, get_compound, list_suppliers · Private data: where_is_it_made · Public sink: where_is_it_made.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_compounds, get_compound, list_suppliers · Private data: where_is_it_made · Public sink: where_is_it_made

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
